contract: Wrap each vpcC FullBox payload in one minimal vp09 movie and open through the MOV demuxer without stream discovery. Fold kind 3 with AVCodecParameters range, colour primaries, transfer and matrix, or kind 8 on refusal. The candidate maps full range to 2 and limited to 1. The MOV CICP projection preserves primaries 0–12 and 22, transfer 0–18 and matrix 0–17. Other values map to unspecified (2). A nonzero initialization size makes the VP9 track projection ineligible; the wire oracle retains all fields and initialization bytes.

For asc, fold kind 2 with declared bits, physical bits and whether they are equal. At each extent in order (declared 0, physical 1), fold kind 3 with scope and channel count for an eligible configuration, or kind 8 with scope on refusal. The candidate caps the decoder policy at 64 channels and disables explicitly coded core frequencies, which the reference decoder refuses at open. The reference supplies the byte extent to avcodec_open2, padding a partial final byte with zero bits. The asc-truncated operation first requires a truncation in the authored exact bit scope and then compares that same padded byte representation. Zero bytes supply no ASC. ASC rate and channel reason appear in the candidate trace. The reference has no initialized rate, profile or frame size at open on this corpus.

For asc-mov, put the declared whole-byte ASC length and the full physical buffer in the DecoderSpecificInfo descriptor of an mp4a track. Fold kind 2 with the published extradata length and exact bytes, followed by kind 3 with the signalled sample rate, core channels and core samples per frame. Fold kind 8 on refusal. For asc-frame, provide the named ASC and the first raw access unit of the pinned ADTS stream to the reference decoder. Fold kind 3 with sample rate, channels and samples per channel, or kind 8. The candidate projects those outputs from the ASC's signalled rate, decoder channels and core frame length. For a two-byte AAC-LC ASC, express a dual-rate decoded frame in core samples at the signalled core rate; record the actual decoded rate and sample count in the trace.

For hvcc-written, compare the hvcC prefix from the authored MP4 with the pinned reference's HEVC parser over the first packet. Fold kind 3 with profile, level, and chroma format and two bit depths minus eight from the parser's public pixel format descriptor. The reference inputs are complete movies written by the pinned release muxer.

For eac3, group each independent syncframe, E-AC-3 or AC-3, and its following dependent syncframes for comparison with the reference demuxer's decoded packet. Fold kind 1 with group offset and byte size, rate, samples, channels, native AVChannel mask, audio service type and matrix encoding. Fold kind 3 for published downmix side data with preferred mode and five linear gains rounded to 10^-5 in this order: center Lo/Ro, center Lt/Rt, surround Lo/Ro, surround Lt/Rt, LFE. Use the ATSC A/52 Annex E locations and level tables. The public downmix mode values for coded 0, 1, 2 and 3 are 0, 2, 1 and 3. Stereo frames in this corpus can publish matrix encoding. The reference publishes downmix side data on the multichannel inputs. Fold kind 7 with packet count on complete input, or kind 8 with the refusal offset.

open_deviations.reading: A byte after the zero codecInitializationDataSize is refused here and ignored by the reference
open_deviations.clause: VP Codec ISO Media File Format Binding v1.0, VP Codec Configuration Box, Syntax and Semantics (codecInitializationDataSize is zero for VP9); it does not say what a reader does with a byte that follows the zero size
open_deviations.candidate: refuses bytes after the zero-length initialization field
open_deviations.reference: reports the colour fields the record codes

open_deviations.reading: The colour fields of a vpcC record lie inside its box
open_deviations.clause: VP Codec ISO Media File Format Binding v1.0, VP Codec Configuration Box, Syntax and Semantics (4 FullBox bytes and 8 fixed record bytes)
open_deviations.candidate: refuses the record that ends before its matrix coefficients
open_deviations.reference: reports a matrix value taken from the byte after the box

open_deviations.reading: A vpcC record cut inside codecInitializationDataSize is refused here; the reference reports its complete colour fields
open_deviations.clause: VP Codec ISO Media File Format Binding v1.0, VP Codec Configuration Box, Syntax and Semantics (4 FullBox bytes and 8 fixed record bytes); it does not say whether a reader may use the colour fields of a record that ends inside codecInitializationDataSize
open_deviations.reference: reports the colour fields, all of which lie inside the box

open_deviations.reading: The AAC-LC configuration reader does not implement channel configuration 13
open_deviations.clause: ISO/IEC 14496-3 clause 1.6.2.1 (AudioSpecificConfig) and 4.4.1 (GASpecificConfig), as documented by AacAscParser (channelConfiguration); ISO/IEC 14496-3:2009/Amd.4 Table 1.19 defines channelConfiguration 13 (22.2), so the input is valid

open_deviations.reading: DecoderSpecificInfo cannot extend beyond its containing descriptor
open_deviations.clause: ISO/IEC 14496-1 DecoderSpecificInfo expandable descriptor extent, as exercised by AacAscScopeParser
open_deviations.candidate: refuses a declared extent of eight bytes backed by seven
open_deviations.reference: publishes eight bytes of extradata and reads a byte beyond the esds box

open_deviations.reading: An explicit SBR extension that ends before sbrPresentFlag is an incomplete configuration
open_deviations.clause: ISO/IEC 14496-3 clause 1.6.2.1 (AudioSpecificConfig syncExtensionType, extensionAudioObjectType and SBR/PS presence flags), as documented by AacAscParser: with 16 bits left the reader takes syncExtensionType 0x2b7 and extension object type 5, and sbrPresentFlag follows
open_deviations.candidate: refuses the 32-bit configuration, whose last 16 bits are the extension type and object type

open_policies.policy: A vpcC box of a version other than 1, or with no version, is refused here and ignored by the reference
open_policies.undecided: VP Codec ISO Media File Format Binding v1.0, VP Codec Configuration Box, Syntax and Semantics (version 1, version 0 deprecated); the binding defines version 1 alone, and skipping a box of an unrecognised version is the general practice of ISO base media readers, so neither result departs from a clause
open_policies.rule: refuses version 0 and version 2 without deriving colour fields
open_policies.reference_rule: opens the entry and reports unknown range and unspecified colour: nothing is read from the box

open_unimplemented.feature: The AAC-LC configuration reader implements no other audio object type
open_unimplemented.clause: ISO/IEC 14496-3 clause 1.6.2.1 (AudioSpecificConfig) and 4.4.1 (GASpecificConfig), as documented by AacAscParser (audioObjectType and the object-specific grammar); audio object types 1 (Main), 3 (SSR), 4 (LTP), 17 (ER LC) and 23 (ER LD) are defined there, so the inputs are valid
open_unimplemented.candidate: refuses the non-LC object type in both scopes
open_unimplemented.reference: opens AAC Main, SSR, LTP, ER LC and ER LD and publishes two channels each
